name: comp-511
title: Single Date Popover Picker
description: A field labelled Date picker: a dark outlined button reading Pick a date beside a calendar icon. Pressing it opens a floating month calendar, and choosing a day rewrites the button with a full date.
use: A form needs one date and the calendar should stay hidden until the field is pressed.
avoid: Only one month is offered at a time, so a date far from the current month takes several arrow clicks.
a11y: The trigger has a linked label and a visible focus outline; the chosen date is only carried as plain button text. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A small label sits above a full-width outlined button with grey placeholder text on the left and a calendar glyph on the right. Opened, a rounded panel below shows a month name between arrows, weekday initials and six rows of day numbers.
behaves: Clicking the button fades the calendar in under it; hovering a day leaves a soft disc and clicking one circles it white while the button text becomes something like November 19th, 2026. The panel stays open after a pick.
customise: The label, placeholder, caption and date format are written in the file; button width and popover alignment are fixed in the source as well.
weight: light: One button and a month calendar drawn only while the popover is open.
demo: November 2026 with 19 chosen; caption reads "Built with React DayPicker".
issues: The open popover covers its own caption line in the opening frames.
Only one month can be reached at a time.
The caption credits the calendar library instead of the control.
polishWhy: Clean labelled trigger and a tidy calendar; the panel overlapping its caption is the only blemish.
